Task 0017: src-tauri/src/commands/emulator.rs -- 6 tauri-specta commands (list_devices/list_images/list_emulators/create_emulator/launch_emulator/stop_emulator) + one EmulatorJob event (job://emulator, mirrors toolchain::BootstrapProgress). AndroidProvider built per-command (like toolchain.rs builds its ports per-call) -- documented consequence: the child-handle map from 0016 doesn't persist, so stop uses the graceful adb emu kill path without a held handle (fine for M2, shared/managed provider is M3). list_devices/list_images done in the SHELL not on the Provider trait (trait sigs can't take manifest bytes/Downloader, and reqwest in emu-android would break 'network behind a port') -- devices::parse_from_jar (new pure fn + zip dep on emu-android) on the installed sdklib jar bytes read from disk, sysimg::parse on the 6 sys-img2-3.xml manifests fetched concurrently via futures_util::try_join_all -- exactly the toolchain::resolve_catalog pattern. New AndroidProvider pub surface: sdk_root (pub), is_image_installed(coord), tracked_states()->Vec<TrackedEmulator> (registry rows + live RunState probed from adb -- lightweight read-only, NOT reconcile()). Registry::list_emulators() added on the emu-core side. Create.tsx rewritten as a 4-step wizard (device search/pick -> image pick with installed/size -> hardware name+RAM+storage -> review -> Create / Create & launch, live job-log panel via useEmulatorJob). Dashboard.tsx rewritten -> useEmulators() list (4s poll) with per-row Launch/Stop. ipc.ts: useDevices/useImages/useEmulators/useCreateEmulator/useLaunchEmulator/useStopEmulator/useEmulatorJob. Wizard scope trims (documented in 0017's Notes + MILESTONES.md): hardware form is name/RAM/storage only (rest default), inline image download folded into 'Create' (runs ensure_image first), 'Save as profile' is M4, uptime needs the launch-timestamp M3 schema, ensure_image progress is a coarse log line not sdkmanager's byte bar. specta quirk: f32 exports as 'number | null', frontend tolerates it. 22 web tests (+9: Create.test.tsx new, Dashboard.test.tsx rewritten), 3 new Rust unit tests -- 114 rust tests total. just validate green (bindings.ts diff is the normal pre-commit regen state -- lefthook stages it). Task 0015: AndroidProvider is emu-android's first real Provider impl; ensure_image delegates to a real sdkmanager invocation (design change made mid-task after a real 720MB system-image install proved sdkmanager already fetches/verifies/unpacks correctly -- no Downloader/zip code), create() drives a real avdmanager create avd -n/-k/-d with all 3 real failure texts classified; EmulatorId::generate() (ulid dep) + Registry::insert_emulator/get_emulator added. Task 0016: launch() spawns 'emulator @<avd>' (+ -no-window/-wipe-data/-no-snapshot-load/-gpu <mode> from LaunchOpts + extra_args -- flags cited from the official emulator-commandline docs, not invented), streams output lines onto the JobHandle, polls 'adb -s <serial> shell getprop sys.boot_completed' until '1' with a wall-clock DEFAULT_BOOT_TIMEOUT (300s, overridable via with_boot_timeout), and fast-fails if the emulator process exits (stream EOF) before boot. The spawned child is HELD in AndroidProvider.running (EmulatorId -> Arc<AsyncMutex<Box<dyn ChildProcess>>>) rather than dropped -- that's what lets stop() reap it ('never orphans') and keeps its stdout drained. stop() does graceful 'adb -s <serial> emu kill' (serial found by matching the registry avd_name against each 'adb -s <s> emu avd name'), waits up to DEFAULT_STOP_TIMEOUT (15s, overridable), then force-kills the held child; idempotent when nothing's running, NotFound for an unknown id. grpc_port left None (M3 detail-panel work). Testing-infra addition in emu-core: FakeProcessRunner::on_spawn_lingering + a FakeChild 'lingering' flag (next_line never resolves after scripted lines, until kill) so the pure timeout path -- stream open, boot never completes -- is testable; a general fake improvement, not a one-off. emu-android tokio deps gained 'time'+'sync' features (no 'rt' -- runs on the caller's runtime). 8 new emu-android tests (launch happy/streams/exits-before-boot/timeout, stop emu-kill/idempotent/unknown-id/force-kill) -- 109 rust tests total in just validate, green. No IPC surface touched, bindings.ts regenerated as a no-op diff. Honest gap (noted in 0016's Notes): no unit test drives a real emulator/adb -- argv/poll-loop/timeout/fallbacks are fake-covered, end-to-end boot is M2's tauri-driver E2E (task 0017) or a future --ignored test; Unix zombie-reap on app-kill is M3 kill-safety. Next: M3 -- Registry & reliable tracking (full SQLite schema + migrations, reconcile() on startup/on-demand, detail panel, wipe/delete/rename, per-emulator log console, kill-safety).
